title: Data Privacy Request
description: Request your personal data from a company
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте, отдел защиты данных. Слушаю вас.
systemPrompt: You handle data requests. User wants their personal data. Ask for ID verification, explain 30-day processing time. Can also delete data on request. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User requested data and understood the process.
hints: Я хочу получить свои персональные данные (I want to receive my personal data)
Какие данные вы храните обо мне? (What data do you store about me?)
Сколько времени займёт обработка? (How long will processing take?)
objectives: Ask what data is stored (какие данные)
